title: The sample blouse (a gift guide)
caption:
Every tailor asks for a sample blouse. Every gift needs one too.

Match to what she already wears. Four from the counter for Diwali, Padwa and Bhaubeej, ₹799 to ₹1,299.

No sample? Send a photo on WhatsApp, +91 95615 57935, and we'll send back three matches with photographs.

Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. The bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you.

[ four gifts · gold tone and two tone · no trial room needed ]

alt_text: An ivory tile. Text reads: The sample blouse. How to match for someone you can't ask. Below it, a fine sage line drawing of a fitted short-sleeved saree blouse on a dark hanger: sloping shoulders, set-in cap sleeves, darts and hooks down its front. A bracelet of polished grey beads with a gold-tone toggle and one puffed gold-tone heart hangs from the hanger's hook. A thin gold thread tied to the hanger runs to an ivory tag with a blush window at its top that reads Shade N° 03, matched to the sample, what she already wears. Small type reads N° 03, a gift guide, and Diwali, Padwa, Bhaubeej.

An ivory tile marked [01]. Text reads: For Aai. Her sample: the cotton she has worn for thirty years. A pinked swatch of pale starched cotton woven in a soft sage gingham check with a fine gold stripe, with the Heartbead Bracelet lying partly across its edge: polished grey beads closed by a gold-tone toggle with one puffed gold-tone heart. A gold thread ties it to an ivory tag with a sage top: Shade N° 03, matched to Aai, gold tone, like the yarn in her check. Below: Heartbead Bracelet, ₹1,299. Polished beads, one puffed gold-tone heart, a toggle at the front. Rhodium plated, two tone.

An ivory tile marked [02]. Text reads: For the friend from the building. Her sample: the dupatta she lent you in 2019. A pinked swatch of blush georgette printed tone on tone with small, close-set coral tulips, buds and sage leaves on a slight bias, with the Ribbon Bead Bracelet lying partly across its edge: a fine gold-tone chain with two heart-cut clear cubic zirconia set side by side as a bow. A gold thread ties it to an ivory tag with a peach top: Shade N° 03, matched to the friend, a fine chain for a busy print. Below: Ribbon Bead Bracelet, ₹799. Two hearts that read as a bow, adjusts from 16 to 19 cm.

An ivory tile marked [03]. Text reads: For Vahini. Her sample: the Paithani she saves for Padwa. A pinked swatch of deep Paithani purple silk with a shot-silk sheen, its bottom edge a wide gold zari border patterned with lozenges below a thin ruby line. The Brushed Gold Huggies, a pair of chunky gold-tone huggie hoops with a soft satin-brushed finish, lie beside it, the left one on the purple silk. A gold thread ties them to an ivory tag with a purple top: Shade N° 03, matched to Vahini, satin, so the zari keeps the shine. Below: Brushed Gold Huggies, ₹999. Satin-brushed rather than mirror-bright, about 12 mm.

An ivory tile marked [04]. Text reads: For you. Kisne diya? Maine. Who gave you that? You did. A pinked swatch of rose-pink georgette woven with small gold four-petal butti, with the Woven Gold Hoops lying partly across its edge: a pair of hoops braided from gold-tone strands. A gold thread ties them to an ivory tag with a rose top: Shade N° 03, matched to you, gold tone on rose, like your butti. Below: Woven Gold Hoops, ₹1,299. 25 mm across, a braided rope, no stones. Then, for the three gold-tone pieces: 02, 03, 04, 18K gold tone plated.

A blush tile. Small type at the top reads N° 03, a gift guide. Text reads: No sample? Send a photo. Tell us who it's for, what she'll wear and your budget. We'll send back three matches, with photographs. A photo print with an ivory border shows the closed blush Naira gift box, its lid printed with the Naira wordmark, among pale rose petals. Below: WhatsApp +91 95615 57935. Mon to Sat, 10 am to 7 pm. Every piece arrives in the Naira gift box.

deviations: S1 bracelet on the hook: at the spec centre (540,300) the hook's crest crossed the strand's top beads mid-bead, and redrawing the hook's top over the cut-out read as the hook piercing the beads. The ring is centred (540,277), still 230 wide at 10deg, so the crest sits inside the loop and the top strand rests on it; the hook's top is not redrawn. Re-checked after the blouse redraw: the loop still lies over the unchanged neckline, toggle and heart over the blouse's right front, nothing crossing the new shoulder lines.

S1 blouse redrawn as a fitted katori blouse at the art director's fix: shoulders slope from (466,300)/(614,300) to (352,322)/(728,322), so 52px of bar shows past each; cap sleeves fall from the shoulder points (curve control (300,350)/(780,350)) to outer hem corners (268,478)/(812,478), hems to the underarms (336,506)/(744,506); armhole seams exactly as given; body from the underarms to (370,712)/(710,712); hem band, dashed centre front, five hooks, waist darts and chalk crosses kept. One change from the fix as written: the side bust darts run from (334,548)/(746,548) toward the waist darts' points but stop at (400,558)/(680,558), 20px short. Run on to (414,560) they met the waist darts' points (420,562) and the two read as one bent seam, like a pocket or a panel line, at full size and in the tile.

S1 sleeve bands: with the redraw they run 14px above and parallel to the new hems and end on the armhole seams at (336.3,491)/(743.7,491), not at the fix's (329,492)/(751,492), which were computed for the old sleeve.

S1 thread tie: the fix's 'two ellipses 8x5' is drawn 5 wide x 8 tall, square to the bar (rotated 9.6deg, the bar's tangent at x762), 3px apart along it, so each reads as a turn of thread round the 6px bar rather than a ring lying along it.
S1 turn line 2 is now three words ('you can’t ask.'), so the turn is a long line over a short one. Set as given; it ends the turn on the point.

Slides 2-5: pieces moved onto their samples exactly as the fix gives (s2 (650,725), s3 (650,720), s5 (650,725), s4 (560,740) at 300 wide); thread anchors moved by the same offset (s4 scaled with the piece) and land on the same native pixel of each cut-out (checked: s2 bead on the lower strand, s3 chain right of the bow, s4 right huggie's lower edge, s5 right hoop's lower edge). Clearance from each piece's opaque pixels to the tag's rotated top/left edge: s2 42px, s3 56px, s4 105px, s5 48px (floor 20), so no cy was lifted.

Slide 2 cotton check (grid-director fix, 26 Oct; it still read as graph paper, thin and perfectly even): rebuilt as a yarn-dyed check, 18px #8FB3AA bands at 35% every 54px both ways, MULTIPLIED, so the crossings darken as dyed yarns do; one 3px #C99A4C stripe 27px off the band's centre (midway between two bands) in every second band, at 90%; every band and stripe jittered up to 0.6px (fixed seed); softened by a 0.4px blur. AI-1 multiplies at .45 (data-tex-opacity, was .30) so the slub crosses the check. History: the spec's 2px-every-22px lines, then fix 2's 5px bands every 40px.

Slide 3 tulip print: motifs 44px tall and leaves 48px as the fix gives, on a 160x80 half-drop drawn as a 160x160 tile so each motif can differ from the one above it: open tulips and buds alternate down each column, rotations alternate +12/-12deg, leaves alternate sides. At an 80px column pitch that is about six columns across the 470px swatch, not the 'about four' the fix estimates; the fix's sizes and repeat were kept over the estimate. Print layer multiply at 90%.

Slide 4 Paithani border built as the fix gives (96px zari field, #E7C27A lozenge chain at 2x centred on the part the 8px teeth leave visible, 10px ruby kath line with 1px #80612A edges on both sides, shot-silk sheen rgba(190,120,190,.18) in screen). The 1px #80612A edge is drawn on the zari side of the kath too, so ruby never meets gold without a line, as in the system's zari band.

Slide 5 butti (grid-director fix, 26 Oct; the round gold dots read as printed paper): woven butti, an 8px four-petal motif (a quatrefoil of r1.75 petals) in #C99A4C, its two upper-left petals lit with a 1px #E7C27A arc, on a half-drop repeat at 44px (88x44 tile), at 92%. That is the 'like your butti' the tag names. The rose (#E9A7A2, luminance .48) now takes the system's mid-tone texture, AI-1 relief soft-light .55 plus AI-1 silk multiply .18. A first try with narrow elliptical petals read as four-pointed stars and was rounded.
Slides 2 and 3: the pale swatches (#F4EBE2 check, #FBEDE9 georgette) carry the system's 1px #E3D9CE edge (data-edge). Without it their pinked teeth disappeared into the ivory ground.
Slide 4 fact line breaks after 'rather than' ('satin-brushed rather than / mirror-bright, about 12 mm.'). A break after the comma would leave 'about 12 mm.' alone on its line.

Slide 6: the WhatsApp number is 36px at b1290 and the kicker is two lines (b1334, b1366) as the fix gives. That makes three Jost lines in the footer against the system's 'two Jost support lines' cap; the art director's fix overrides it because the one line was unreadable in feed. Both kicker lines are ink-soft #3D3530, not warm grey #6B625B (4.11:1 on blush, under the 4.5:1 floor; ink-soft is 8.28:1). Fallback: only the number changed.

Slide 6 photo: the box spans native x430-1110 of the 1200-wide frame, so a 760x560 cover-crop cannot centre it horizontally without cutting it. The crop runs the full width with the box centred vertically (object-position 50% 60%); the image is shown 732px wide inside the 14px border (native 1200).

Spec updated to match (briefs/option-a.json, post 3): slide 1 turn and tag copy, the blouse geometry, the slide 2-5 positions and swatch recipes, the slide 6 footer and the alt text, each appended to its build as 'FIX 25 Oct'.

FIX 2 (25 Oct), s1 eyebrow: 'N° 03 · A GIFT GUIDE', the art director's first option, so the series name is carried by the headline as on P1 ('N° 01 · OPEN FOR THE SEASON') rather than by the system's series eyebrow. The cover now says THE SAMPLE BLOUSE in the headline and THE SAMPLE on the tag, and says 'gift' once. Eyebrow ends x388, clear of the x>=907 icon zone.

FIX 2, s2 and s5 tag details: the fix's 'gold, like the yarn / in her check' and 'gold on rose, / like your butti' are set 'gold tone, like the yarn / in her check' and 'gold tone on rose, / like your butti'. Bare 'gold' about a piece is on the brand bible's never-list (rule 1: never 'gold' alone; use 'gold tone'). Both still fit the tag: s2 line 1 is 162px at 20px, s5 line 1 122px. s3 'a fine chain / for a busy print' and s4 'satin, so the zari / keeps the shine' are exactly as given.

FIX 2, s4 huggie matte: the fix offers 'alpha erode 1px plus a 0.6px Gaussian, or re-matte at 2x and downsample'; the second route was taken, at 4x. The binary matte is re-drawn at 4x, its contour smoothed (Gaussian sigma 1.5 native px, re-thresholded) so the stair-steps go, eroded 1 native px (the outermost column was a ~50% plaster/metal blend), then box-downsampled to a 1px anti-aliased ramp (16 alpha levels). Erode plus a 0.6px Gaussian was rendered and rejected: on the left huggie's left edge the near-white highlight spread into a lavender fringe on the Paithani purple. Saved as a new key, cutouts/brushed-gold-huggies/00-aa-trim.png (370x227, registered in _system/cutouts.js); 00-trim.png is untouched.

FIX 2, s4 nubs: the fix's nub at about native (13,88) measured at x=12, rows 87-95 (left huggie, left edge); a second plaster nub of the same kind, x=142 rows 134-155 (left huggie, right edge), was removed too. Both are alpha-only removals.
